This Field Procedure covers the steps required to unlock [[Etienne Dorn]]. For his location, Blueprint grades, and Experimental Effects, see the Engineer reference page.

== Objective ==

Gain access to Etienne Dorn's ship-module Engineering services at '''Kraken's Retreat''' on '''Los A 2 b''' in the [[Colonia]] region.

== Prerequisites ==

{{Prerequisites|
* '''Referral:''' Gain sufficient reputation with [[Liz Ryder]] to receive Etienne Dorn's referral.
* '''Rank:''' Reach the Pilots Federation Trade rank of '''Dealer''' or higher.
* '''Cargo:''' Carry '''25 units of Occupied Escape Pods'''.
* '''Capacity:''' Fit enough cargo space for the pods being transported.
}}

The maintained references place Liz Ryder's referral during Grade 3 access, after roughly one-third of the progress towards Grade 4. Reaching Grade 4 also satisfies that condition.<ref name="inara">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/23/ INARA: Etienne Dorn], accessed 14 September 2026.</ref><ref name="wiki">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Etienne_Dorn Elite Dangerous Wiki: Etienne Dorn], accessed 14 September 2026.</ref>

== Preparation ==

Occupied Escape Pods are cargo rather than Engineering materials. Each unit consumes one tonne of cargo capacity and can be lost if the ship is destroyed.

Recover unbound pods from salvage sources such as appropriate distress or signal-source encounters. Do not rely on cargo assigned to an active mission: mission-owned items may be reserved for that mission rather than available for an Engineer donation. A [[Collector Limpet Controller]] can shorten repeated salvage collection, but it is not required.

The workshop is in the Colonia region. Commanders beginning in the Bubble should decide whether to obtain the pods before departure or source them after arrival; transporting all 25 at once requires at least 25 tonnes of free cargo space.

== Procedure ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Increase reputation with [[Liz Ryder]] until Etienne Dorn's referral appears in the Engineers panel.
# Reach the Trade rank of '''Dealer''' or higher through profitable commodity sales.
# Acquire 25 units of non-mission '''Occupied Escape Pods'''.
# Confirm that all 25 are present in the ship's cargo hold and that no mission marker reserves them for another delivery.
# Travel to the '''Los''' system and land at '''Kraken's Retreat''' on '''Los A 2 b'''.
# Open Engineer Workshop services and donate the 25 Occupied Escape Pods.
# Confirm that Etienne's Engineering services are available before leaving the base.
}}

== Expected result ==

{{Expected result|[[Etienne Dorn]] is unlocked at Kraken's Retreat and his Power Plant and Life Support Engineering services are available.}}

Unlocking the workshop does not immediately grant every Blueprint grade. Apply Engineering modifications or sell exploration data at Kraken's Retreat to increase [[Engineer Reputation]] and open the higher grades he offers.

== Troubleshooting ==

;Etienne does not appear in the Engineers panel
:Check both the Liz Ryder reputation threshold and the Dealer Trade rank. A new game session may be required after the referral condition is crossed.

;The donation option is unavailable
:Verify that the pods are ordinary cargo in the current ship, not mission cargo or stored on another vessel. The full unlock quantity is 25 units.

;The route to Los cannot be plotted
:Los is in the Colonia region, approximately 22,000 light-years from the Bubble. Review the [[Colonia]] travel context and confirm the ship's plotted-route settings and jump range.
